newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bond prices ended sharply lower, extending recent declines on modest volume.

Traders said pressure on Swiss prices increased after the June confederate bond futures contract broke below support at 117.50, falling to a contract low of 117.17. It closed above session lows at 117.32, down 34 basis points.
Swiss traders saw prices driven lower by weakness in German bonds. German prices fell on news of stronger than expected February industrial production data.
"With us in Switzerland, the economy is still weak. But we are very strongly oriented towards Germany," one trader said.
As expected, the Swiss National Bank left its discount rate unchanged at Thursday's weekly meeting. The discount rate currently matches an historic low of one percent.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down 15 at 110.90
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 up two at 98.15.
